notable_docs.one_line: The one design law (Huang ICLR'24): intrinsic same-context self-correction FAILS/degrades -> every self-check must anchor to an EXTERNAL signal (tool result, independent sample, fresh-context reviewer, written rubric); hooks TRIGGER, only a separate model JUDGES. Maps the 4 failure modes (tunnel/sunk-cost/no-recall/no-capture) to honest coverage.
